Born to parents that owned and operated a restaurant and a hotel in Bordeaux (near Blaye) Guy Azera grew up amongst vineyards & winemakers.
After moving to Los Angeles in 1977, he made it his life’s work to share the stories and the history that enriched his upbringing.
From the generations of winemakers who pour their lives into their craft, to those enjoying the fruit of their labor - and everyone in between - The Wine Source Inc. takes pride in sharing authentic wines with those that appreciate them.

Regal Wine Company
Your Gateway to Wine.
California’s preeminent wine distributor.
Maison Louis Jadot is a winery that was founded by Louis Henry Denis Jadot in 1859. The first vineyard bought by the Jadot family is the Beaune vineyard, Clos des Ursules, in 1826.
Being a family-owned winery absolutely affects our winemaking. It affords us the luxury to take the long view. We can take risks and grow our grapes in mountain and hillside vineyards- even though it is more difficult for both the farmer and the vine.
We’re the ladies of Maker, here to serve up award-winning wine for discerning palates and the good of human kind.
Rick Quinn and David Nichols were first neighbors, then friends, and finally collaborators in a shared dream: to create their own winemaking legacy in Paso Robles.
Sunny with a Chance of Flowers is a healthy lifestyle wine created to make you feel good inside and out. ZERO sugar, 85 calories (per 5oz serving), 9% alcohol and positively delicious, it seems too good to be true. But Sunny is the real deal – better for you and mindfully made.
Our story begins with a piece of land, a family passionate about wine, and a community of friends and partners who helped bring Cakebread Cellars to life. Since founding the winery in 1973, we’ve set out to create quality wines that pair best with good food and good company.
